messages.subject: including image via HTML within Shiny
parts:
I'm trying to include a picture in my shiny page, and for design reasons I need to use an HTML tag to load the picture.

I'm trying to use

<img src=\'plot.jpg\'>

within the HTML code, but I get the little icon that indicates the image can't be found.  Where should I put the image file so that Shiny / the HTML within Shiny will be able to find it?  

Thanks,
Ben
